tools.name: diag_get_status
tools.description: Show the state of this system in one view: the TUR build and version, the kernel, the boot identifier and how many system units have failed. Reads only; nothing is collected or sent anywhere.

tools.name: diag_report_prepare
tools.description: Prepare a problem report for TUR's developers and show exactly what it would contain: the report text after personal data is removed, every file of the diagnostic bundle with its size, and how many identifiers were replaced. Preview only: nothing is saved and nothing is sent. Give a title and a component, or from_boot_health to report a failed update that boot health recorded. Only the person can send a report, after reading it.

title.description: One line that names the problem.

error_code.description: A TUR error code such as TUR-BOOT-GATE-003, if one is known.

from_boot_health.description: Make the report from boot health's notice of a failed update or a failed start.

tools.name: diag_report_list
tools.description: List the problem reports this person has sent, with their last known state (received, filed, or fixed in a version), and those prepared but not sent. Reads only.

tools.name: heal_list_faults
tools.description: List the problems TUR's healing service has found on this computer and not yet resolved: what it saw, what was already done, and the repairs for each with their class and how they are undone; and the problems resolved recently. Reads only.

tools.name: heal_explain
tools.description: Explain one problem TUR knows: what it is in plain words, each repair, what it changes, its class, whether TUR applies it by itself and how it is undone; and its record on this computer, if any. Reads only.

code.description: The problem's code, as heal_list_faults shows it.

tools.name: heal_apply_remedy
tools.description: Ask TUR's healing service to apply one repair to a problem it has found, and check that the repair worked. The service refuses a problem that is not present now, a repair that cannot be undone (only the person can apply those, as administrator) and a repair asked for too often. Tell the person what the repair changes before asking for it.

code.description: The problem's code, as heal_list_faults shows it.

remedy.description: The repair's name, as heal_explain shows it.

tools.name: heal_undo_remedy
tools.description: Ask TUR's healing service to undo a repair that was applied, putting back what it changed. TUR then does not apply that repair by itself again until the problem is resolved.

code.description: The problem's code, as heal_list_faults shows it.

remedy.description: The repair's name, as heal_explain shows it.
